cslediagnostic.display.name: Chinese Expression Diagnostic
cslediagnostic.checkGlyph.desc: Select the Chinese glyph you want to check
cslediagnostic.convertGlyph.desc: Select the Chinese glyph you want to convert (not the same as check glyphs)
cslediagnostic.checkDocComment.title: Documentation comments
cslediagnostic.checkDocComment.desc: Documentation comments (Dart, JavaScript/TypeScript, PHP, Python only; not supported for HTML, CSS, JSON)
cslediagnostic.excludeNames.desc: Exclude names (keys/fields/tags/function names/method chains) from checking (such as title, div, print, console.log, i18n.t, etc.)
cslediagnostic.excludeMethods.desc: Exclude names (keys/fields/tags/function names/method chains) from checking (such as title, div, print, console.log, i18n.t, etc.)
cslediagnostic.traditional.tw.desc: Check for Chinese (as used in Taiwan)
cslediagnostic.traditional.hk.desc: Check for Chinese (as used in Hong Kong)
cslediagnostic.workspaceExclude.desc: Extra glob patterns excluded when diagnosing all files or a folder (node_modules, .git, out, dist, build and files.exclude are always excluded)
cslediagnostic.maxFileSize.desc: Maximum file size (KB) scanned when diagnosing all files or a folder; larger files are skipped
cslediagnostic.previewBeforeApply.desc: Review the changes in VS Code's Refactor Preview before applying Accept All / Accept File / Accept
cslediagnostic.saveAfterApply.desc: Save the modified files after accepting changes (off by default; changes can be undone while unsaved)
cslediagnostic.autoDiagnosticOnOpen.desc: Automatically diagnose the whole workspace after opening a project and list the results in the Chinese Expression Diagnostic view. Files are never modified automatically. Large projects may take a while; use workspaceExclude / maxFileSize to limit the scope. Not applied in untrusted workspaces.
cslediagnostic.autoDiagnosticMaxFiles.de: Maximum number of files for automatic diagnosis on open; if the workspace has more files, the automatic run is skipped (the manual command is not limited).
